standfirst: Cosavirus, Dicipivirus and Tremovirus: three genera with no leader and the four-capsid-protein layout. Cosavirus is a human enteric virus; Tremovirus is avian encephalomyelitis virus. Too small to model separately, identical in organisation, so built as one module.

modules.PICO_NOLDR_VP4: Cosavirus, Dicipivirus, Tremovirus. The 2A slot was split on the genus: Cosavirus 2A is 31 residues against 141-164 for Tremovirus and Dicipivirus, which is a different protein rather than a short form.

gaps: No declared feature lacks a profile. Dicipivirus is unusual in the family for having a dicistronic genome, which this module does not attempt to represent - it models the polyprotein products only.
derived: All mature peptides are cleavage products of POLY with both extensions set to 0.
